title_sq: SUPER APARTAMENT 2+1+2 PËR SHITJE, KOPSHTI BOTANIK !

title_en: SUPER APARTMENT 2+1+2 FOR SALE, BOTANICAL GARDEN!
description_en: Modern Apartment for Sale near the Botanical Garden & Artificial Lake, Tirana A modern style apartment with an area of ​​109 m² is offered for sale, located on the 3rd floor of a private, safe and well-managed residence, in one of the most sought-after areas of Tirana. ✨ Main features: Total area: 109 m² Floor: 3 (with elevator) 2 spacious bedrooms 2 bathrooms with windows, complete Living room & open space kitchen with natural lighting Balcony with a relaxing view of the Artificial Lake Large windows, with perfect orientation for light throughout the day Quality construction with thermal & acoustic insulation Secured and professionally maintained residence 🏡 An ideal opportunity for both comfortable family living and long-term investment in an elite area of the capital.
